nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an infinite set of natural numbers whose counting function $A(N) = |A \cap \{1, \dots, N\}|$ satisfies $A(N)/N \to 0$ as $N \to \infty$, and let $D(N)$ be the number of integers $d \in \{1, \dots, N\}$ of the form $d = a - b$ with $a, b \in A$. Then $\limsup_{N \to \infty} D(N)/A(N) = +\infty$, where the ratio is computed in the extended reals and taken to be $0$ when $A(N) = 0$.
nodes.title: Ruzsa's theorem on difference sets of sparse sets

nodes.summary: The proposition asserts the following for every infinite set $A$ of natural numbers. Write $A(N) = |A \cap \{1, \dots, N\}|$ for its counting function and $D(N)$ for the number of integers $d \in \{1, \dots, N\}$ of the form $d = a - b$ with $a, b \in A$. If $A(N)/N \to 0$ as $N \to \infty$, then $\limsup_{N \to \infty} D(N)/A(N) = +\infty$.
nodes.title: Erdős Problem 899 on difference sets of sparse sets
